newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech target raised.

text.p: Lehman Brothers raised its one-year price target for Orbotech shares to $38-$40 from a prior $30 target and reaffirmed a 1-Buy rating for the Israeli company.
The shares closed on Friday at $31-7/8.

"The healthy tone of business gives us increased confidence of upside to our 1997 and 1998 estimates, which currently stand at $1.99 and $2.35 (a share), respectively," Lehman analyst Ted Kundtz said in a report released on Sunday.

Despite a 33 percent run-up in the stock over the last month, the valuation remains attractive as the stock continues to sell at a sizeable discount to Orbotech's growth rate and its peers, the report said.
Orbotech makes automated optical inspection equipment for the printed circuit industry.
